title: Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO Details
intro:
Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO is a book build issue of ₹177.81 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.53 crore shares aggregating to ₹142.69 crores and offer for sale of 0.13 crore shares aggregating to ₹35.12 crores.

Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO opens for subscription on Aug 3, 2026 and closes on Aug 5, 2026. The allotment for the Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 6, 2026. Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 10, 2026.

Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO is set issue price band at ₹257 to ₹270 per share. The lot size for an application is 400 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,16,000 (800 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,200 shares), amounting to ₹3,24,000.

Hem Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Hem Finlease Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in January 2021, Anawil Wire and Engineering Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of windmill towers, specializing in the fabrication of heavy and precision steel components for the wind energy sector. The company manufactures customized tubular steel wind turbine towers of up to 140 meters in height for leading Wind Turbine Generator (WTG) OEMs and renewable energy companies.

The company operates two advanced manufacturing facilities in Koppal, Karnataka and Kutch, Gujarat, with a combined annual production capacity of 612 windmill towers. Its facilities are equipped with modern fabrication, welding, testing, and quality control infrastructure, enabling the production of high-quality wind turbine towers that comply with international standards.

Leveraging strategically located manufacturing facilities and strong steel fabrication capabilities, Anawil has expanded its presence in India's fast-growing renewable energy sector. The company follows stringent quality standards and is certified under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, and ISO 3834-2:2021 for manufacturing windmill towers and heavy fabricated structures.

Led by experienced promoters and a professional management team, the company focuses on operational efficiency, quality manufacturing, and long-term customer relationships. As of May 31, 2026, Anawil Wire and Engineering employed 95 full-time professionals across production, quality, engineering, finance, administration, and sales functions, supported by 767 contract workers.
strengths: Modern in-house manufacturing facilities with stringent quality control systems.
Strong order book and strategic positioning in the growing wind energy sector.
Manufacturing facilities strategically located for operational and logistics efficiency.
Proven expertise in customized heavy steel fabrication for wind turbine towers.

faqs.question: How to apply in Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Anawil Wire & Engineering IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
